_comment: Hand-computed normalization suggestions for a sample of fixtures/clean.csv rows. rowId = 'row-N' (1-indexed data row, header excluded). Rules: lowercase_trim_email (email -> trim+lowercase), canonicalize_phone_format (strip all formatting chars but keep leading '+' and digits), normalize_name_casing (trim, collapse whitespace, title-case each word). A suggestion is only emitted when suggestedValue differs from originalValue.
note: This is a representative sample, not exhaustive — most clean.csv rows have phone formatting characters (spaces/dashes) and would also produce a canonicalize_phone_format suggestion. A suggestion is only emitted when suggestedValue differs from originalValue; a test asserting on these three rows should not assume other rows produce zero suggestions.
